_caveat: CALIBRATION SET, NOT PREDICTIVE VALIDITY. 22 hand-built fixtures exercise the detector rules; they do not measure real-world defect detection, employer agreement, or hiring validity. Precision/recall here calibrate the prototype against its own spec.
_doc: AI-11 calibration benchmark. Labels are the author's expectations of what the DETERMINISTIC detectors should flag (bug+security only; risks/notes are reported, not scored). Labels were written from the documented detector trigger rules before running. Fixtures marked blind_spot:true document genuine detector limitations — they are honest misses, not failures to fix here.
